invented.quote: The 9 new clinics we added made up for that loss.
invented.why: The brief does not specify how much revenue the 9 new clinics added, how much the other 3 lost clinics paid, or whether existing customers changed their spending to keep total revenue flat.
The brief only states that one lost customer moved to the scheduler built into their electronic records system, not that records vendors in general are bundling scheduling.

invented.quote: Independent and smaller clinics are a different situation
invented.why: The brief does not mention independent or smaller clinics or how their situation differs from chains.

invented.quote:
There are two reasons:
1. It's the part of our product with proven, measurable value.
2. It lets us sell to clinics that are happy with their current scheduler, including the ones built into records systems, so we don't have to compete with those schedulers head-on.
invented.why: The brief states that the reminder feature will be sold on its own, but gives no reasons for this decision and does not state that it can work alongside other schedulers.
